purpose: Establish, on a live Ollama, where a context-usage note and a compaction summary are placed in a model's context per family, and mirror the Decision as placement data for S4-S6.

public_api.name: PLACEMENT_NOTE_POSITIONS / PLACEMENT_SUMMARY_ROLES
public_api.description: Declared wire positions for the note and roles for the summary.

public_api.name: CONTEXT_PLACEMENT
public_api.signature: { note: NotePlacement; summary: SummaryPlacement; exceptions: Record<string, { note?: NotePlacement; summary?: SummaryPlacement }> }
public_api.description: Decision table as data: one default each plus per-family exceptions (S-PLACEMENT data part).

external_ports: Ollama HTTP API (research probes only, not production)
